scope: Bybit-native BTCUSDT top-five L2 cancellation/withdrawal, aggressive-trade depletion and replenishment decomposition on a 100ms point-in-time clock; gradient-boosted multi-horizon return forecast; taker entry after explicit latency; one global slot; fixed forecast-horizon exit with adverse BBO stop; 12/18/24bp account replay. Stage-one fit is 2022-07-01 and independent development is 2023-07-01. All 2024-2026 data are mechanically prohibited.
non_overlap: Distinct from passive maker/queue-fill studies because every entry and exit is aggressive and no passive-fill probability is modeled. Distinct from ordinary event-tape, match-sweep, completed-bar imbalance, cross-venue and movement-hazard studies because the primary state is the residual change of five-level displayed depth after subtracting contemporaneous aggressive executions, including refill speed and cancellation-only withdrawal.
